title: Two Hamzahs in One Word - An interrogative hamzah before a hamzat al-waṣl.
titleEn: Two Hamzahs in One Word - An interrogative hamzah before a hamzat al-waṣl.
description: When an interrogative hamzah (همزة الاستفهام) precedes a hamzat al-waṣl. This occurs across 3 words occuring for a total of 6 times throughout the quran: ءَآلذَّكَرَيْنِ, آللَّهُ, آلْآنَ.

madd_lazim.title: Madd lāzim
madd_lazim.description: One of the agreed upon methods for making takhfif in this scenario is that hamzat al-waṣl will be changed to an alif. Since a hamzat al-wasl is always followed by a sākin letter after this change we will have a fatha followed by an alif (madd asli) followed by a permanent sukoon thereby creating madd lazim.

tashil_of_hamzat_al_wasl.title: Tashῑl of hamzat al-waṣl
tashil_of_hamzat_al_wasl.description: The other agreed upon method of takhfif in this scenario is to make tashῑl of the hamzat al-wasl. The first hamzah(the interrogative hamzah) will be read with taḥqῑqand the second (the hamzat al-wasl) with tashῑl.
